name: 02045 · Hull, MA
findings: ZIP 02045 (Hull) has 27 nonprofit organizations. 10 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is volunteering, listed by 7 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 02045 (Hull) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 02045 (Hull) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 46% of the typical level).
